title: Salary alongside department max
prompt: Return every employee's name, dept, and salary, plus a fourth column dept_max_salary showing the maximum salary within that employee's own department. You must compute dept_max_salary using a correlated scalar subquery placed in the SELECT list (not a JOIN or window function).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE emp7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary REAL); INSERT INTO emp7 VALUES (1,'Alice','Engineering',90000),(2,'Bob','Engineering',75000),(3,'Carol','Engineering',95000),(4,'Dan','Sales',60000),(5,'Eve','Sales',65000),(6,'Frank','HR',50000);
reference_sql: SELECT name, dept, salary, (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM emp7 e2 WHERE e2.dept = e1.dept) AS dept_max_salary FROM emp7 e1;
